items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses playing in a band with 'Wild Bill Davison' and mentions 'Chubb Stein-berg' only in the interviewer's question as a point of comparison ('This was a step above Chubb Stein-berg'). The interviewee does not mention any personal interaction, collaboration, or relationship with

ctx.x: Oh, no - at this time, they were on the road and they were playing all the big cities in the Midwest. You know, Detroit, Cleveland, Cincinnati - around in that territory--- and, some in New York, I think; they played there too. But, you know, they had made Victor records and, you know, records were a big thing then too. So, they had a big name and, of course, you know, I wanted to be with that band. And, so, they came and do you know that he kept us there about 16 weeks with that band. It just was an amazing…
This was a step above Chubb Stein- berg, I gather---

Oh, Lord yes -- it was really a class band--- you know. And, the fact that he liked--- Eddie liked my mellophone and he used to feature me on the mellophone; they'd make an arrangement and build it around my mellophone.
